SOURCE EXCERPT:
A programme seeking approval for fully online delivery demonstrates readiness against each of the four readiness indicators: an instructional-design review completed within the previous two years, a student-support plan covering advising and technical help at the hours the programme runs, an assessment plan with at least one proctored or otherwise identity-verified component per course, and a faculty development record showing every instructor certified for online teaching. The readiness review is conducted by the Office of Digital Learning and forwarded to the University Curriculum Committee with a recommendation. A programme that falls short on one indicator may be approved provisionally for one year, during which the shortfall must be corrected; provisional approval is not renewable. Programmes approved before this policy took effect are reviewed at their next scheduled programme review rather than immediately.
